captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a professional camera flash speedlight. It features a tall, rectangular black control body with an integrated rear LCD display and control buttons, mounted on a hot shoe foot. Above the body, a dual-arm yoke supports the rectangular flash head, which features a translucent grey front lens and a white slide-out bounce card at the top. The flash head swivels horizontally on a vertical joint above the body, tilts vertically on a horizontal axis between the yoke arms, and the bounce card slides linearly out of its top slot.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of an articulated camera flash accessory. It must include a tall base body with a hot shoe mount and rear controls, a yoke assembly that swivels horizontally on top of the base, a rectangular flash head that tilts vertically between the yoke arms, and a white bounce card that slides vertically out of the top of the flash head.
captions.factory: The model is constructed in four parts. First, the base body is created using a main rectangular box, a smaller hot shoe foot box, and rear interface display boxes. Second, a yoke part is modeled using a vertical cylinder pin, a horizontal bar box, and two vertical side-arm boxes. Third, the flash head is built from a hollowed-out box with a front lens insert and lateral pivot cylinders. Fourth, the bounce card is modeled as a thin plate. These parts are connected using a revolute joint for the horizontal swivel, a revolute joint for the vertical tilt, and a prismatic joint for the sliding bounce card.
